PLEXTRAC_CLIENT_ID.description: Server-side PlexTrac client-scope predicate forwarded as the client_id=<id> query parameter on GET /api/v1/findings. Optional; empty / blank walks the entire identity's client scope (the typical operational mode for first-time imports). Comma-separated ids / uuids are split, trimmed and deduplicated, then forwarded as multiple client_id=<id> entries so a single agent can pull findings from several clients in one run (e.g. 'acme-prod,acme-staging'). PlexTrac accepts either the numeric id or the uuid (whichever the operator pasted in is forwarded verbatim); the operator's PLEXTRAC_USER / PLEXTRAC_PASSWORD identity scope still applies. Whitespace is trimmed around each entry.

PLEXTRAC_REPORT_ID.description: Server-side PlexTrac report-scope predicate forwarded as the report_id=<id> query parameter on GET /api/v1/findings. Optional; empty / blank walks the entire client's report scope. Comma-separated ids / uuids are split, trimmed and deduplicated, then forwarded as multiple report_id=<id> entries so a single agent can pull findings from several reports in one run (e.g. 'acme-q1-pentest,acme-mobile-q1'). PlexTrac accepts either the numeric id or the uuid (whichever the operator pasted in is forwarded verbatim); the operator's PLEXTRAC_USER / PLEXTRAC_PASSWORD identity scope still applies. Whitespace is trimmed around each entry.

name: plextrac
title: PlexTrac
description: PlexTrac pentest finding importer. Pulls validated findings from the PlexTrac REST API and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON. PlexTrac is a pentest reporting and collaboration platform — internal red teams and external consultants author findings during scoped engagements and the platform tracks the resulting findings through an Open / In Process / Closed lifecycle. This executor surfaces validated findings under the operator's existing Faraday workspace so the external pentest pipeline joins the dispatcher's internal scanner output. Endpoints used: POST https://api.plextrac.com/api/v1/authenticate (login endpoint — body {'username': '...', 'password': '...'}, response envelope {'token': '<JWT>'} returned by older PlexTrac releases; newer multi-tenant releases expose it under access_token / jwt / data.token — all shapes are tolerated by extract_token. The returned JWT is forwarded verbatim on every subsequent /api/v1/ request as the Authorization: Bearer <token> header value). GET https://api.plextrac.com/api/v1/findings?client_id=<id>&report_id=<id>&limit=N&offset=M (paginated finding feed; canonical envelope is {'data': [{...}], 'total': N} on newer releases or a bare list on older releases; each record carries flaw_id / id, title, severity ('Critical' / 'High' / 'Medium' / 'Low' / 'Informational' — PlexTrac's published label ladder), status ('Open' / 'In Process' / 'Closed' / 'Mitigated' / 'Accepted Risk' / 'Resolved' — PlexTrac's published state machine), description (finding write-up), recommendations (remediation guidance), references (free-text refs body), affected_assets (dict of scoped asset id -> {'asset': '<url>', 'status': '...'} for the assets the finding hits), cvss / cvss_vector, cve / cwe (attributed CVE / CWE strings), client_id / report_id, assignedTo / createdBy (PlexTrac user identifiers), created_at / updated_at / closed_at / last_update (epoch seconds or ISO 8601), tags (operator-set free-text tags)). The /api/v1/clients/<id>/reports endpoint is documented for operator reference (the dispatcher never fetches it directly — operators paste the relevant PLEXTRAC_REPORT_ID into the manifest argument). Auth: PlexTrac's REST surface uses a short-lived JWT minted from the operator's long-lived PLEXTRAC_USER + PLEXTRAC_PASSWORD pair (PlexTrac's documented v1 auth shape — the username + password are posted to /api/v1/authenticate, the returned JWT identifies the user identity on every subsequent request). PLEXTRAC_HOST is an env-only override (defaults to https://api.plextrac.com — almost every PlexTrac tenant runs on its own <tenant>.plextrac.com subdomain so this env var typically needs to be set to the operator's tenant URL); whitespace is trimmed and https:// is added when the operator pasted in a bare FQDN. Pagination is offset-based via limit=N + offset=M (PlexTrac caps limit at 100); walks until len(records) < page_size or the env-only PLEXTRAC_PAGES knob is reached (default 10, clamped to [1, 100]). 401 short-circuits the whole executor (credentials are wrong or the JWT expired); 403 / 429 / 5xx stop pagination and return what we have. Each PlexTrac finding becomes one Faraday host with host.ip set to the 0.0.0.0 sentinel (pentest findings are keyed on a URL / asset path rather than an IP); the finding title and the affected-asset URL land on host.hostnames; the finding itself becomes one Faraday vulnerability with the [PENTEST] engine prefix so external pentester findings land alongside the other crowd-sourced feeds. Severity bucketing: PlexTrac's published label vocabulary is 'Critical' / 'High' / 'Medium' / 'Low' / 'Informational'; 'Informational' / 'None' map to Faraday's 'info' bucket so the finding is still visible. The nested {'rating': '...', 'score': 0..10} shape used by some federated mirrors is tolerated — the rating is preferred and the 0..10 score is used as a fallback (CVSS v3 ranges: 0.0 -> info, 0.1..3.9 -> low, 4.0..6.9 -> medium, 7.0..8.9 -> high, 9.0..10.0 -> critical). Closed PlexTrac statuses (Closed / Resolved / Mitigated / Accepted Risk) are floored to 'info' regardless of the published rating (preserved via an explicit PlexTrac-Status pivot). Unparseable / missing severity defaults to 'info'. Status is always 'open' so the operator's remediation workflow takes over; the closed status is preserved via the info-severity floor + the PlexTrac-Status pivot. Refs include explicit PlexTrac-FindingID / PlexTrac-Client / PlexTrac-Report / PlexTrac-Assignee / PlexTrac-Status / PlexTrac-Severity / PlexTrac-Substatus / PlexTrac-CreatedAt / PlexTrac-UpdatedAt / PlexTrac-LastUpdate / PlexTrac-ClosedAt / PlexTrac-Source / PlexTrac-VulnerableURL / PlexTrac-Asset / PlexTrac-Tag / PlexTrac-CVSSVector / PlexTrac-CVSSScore / PlexTrac-Impact / PlexTrac-Likelihood pivots, plus the canonical https://app.plextrac.com/client/<id> / https://app.plextrac.com/client/<id>/report/<id> / https://app.plextrac.com/client/<id>/report/<id>/finding/<id> permalinks and the canonical NVD CVE + MITRE CWE permalinks for any CVE / CWE ids surfaced in the cve / cwe / title / description / recommendations / references fields. Tags: [plextrac, pentest-platforms, finding].
